types.name: SIM Swap

required.label: Calling Number
required.info:
[SAKA SCEK-0002 / SSCB-0006]
Calling number must be active on IN-Data. Maximum 2 swap requests per 24 hours.

required.label: Line to Swap
required.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
Must be active on CBS, not pooled/deleted, not self-whitelisted (*100*100#). Line must be off or verified.

required.label: Full Names // View 360
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Full names as registered on View 360. Must completely match registration.

required.label: ID Number
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Original registered document number. Leading zeros do not invalidate ID.

required.label: Year of Birth
required.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Year of birth as per View 360 & Siebel records.

required.label: New SIMEX Serial
required.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
20-digit serial number from replacement SIM card retailing at KES 100.

optional.label: FDN 1 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Frequently Dialled Number: Must be Mobile Originated (MO) call or SMS at least twice in the last 3 months. FDN 1 & 2 together count as 1 pass.

optional.label: FDN 2 // 2x in 3 mos
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Second Frequently Dialled Number. Together with FDN 1 counts as 1 secondary pass.

optional.label: Airtime Balance
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Current airtime balance on CBS IN-Data.

optional.label: Self-Txn 1 // Last 30d
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Self-initiated M-PESA transaction from customer account in last 30 days. Must provide Amount, Date/Time, and Recipient name. (2 txns count as 1 pass).

optional.label: Self-Txn 2 // Last 30d
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Second self-initiated M-PESA transaction in last 30 days.

optional.label: Fuliza Limit // SAKA CBS
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Accurate Fuliza overdraft limit required. Do NOT use if customer has not opted in.

optional.label: M-Shwari Limit // SAKA CBS
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Accurate M-Shwari loan limit required. Do NOT use if customer has not opted in.

optional.label: KCB M-PESA Limit // SAKA CBS
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Accurate KCB M-PESA loan limit required. Do NOT use if customer has not opted in.

optional.label: Storo Target // Prepay CBS
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Daily Storo Bonus target amount for prepay subscribers.

optional.label: Active Bundle Plan // Data / Voice
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Customer active recurring or purchased bundle plan name / price.

optional.label: Registration Date // Month & Year
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Month and Year of Line registration or M-PESA registration.

optional.label: Last Bundle Purchase
optional.info:
[SAKA VMDA-0001]
Customer to provide bundle name or price purchased.

optional.label: Alternative Number
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
10-digit alternative contact number.

optional.label: Apps Wiped // CRM
optional.info:
[SAKA SKKI-0001 / VMDA-0001]
Post-swap mandatory security: CEE must wipe out mySafaricom App, MyOne App, and M-PESA Apps on CRM.

optional.label: Not Active // IN-Data
optional.info:
[SAKA SCEK-0002 / SSCB-0006]
Calling number must be active on IN-Data (Active or Expiry status). If terminated or inactive, decline swap.
optional.violationAdvice: Calling number is not active on IN-Data. Declined and referred customer to visit Retail Center.

optional.label: Swapped <72h // Calling Line
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006 / SCEK-0002]
If calling number was swapped in last 72 hours (unless M-PESA agent line), decline swap and refer to retail or advise to call via an agent line for assistance.
optional.violationAdvice: Calling number swapped within last 72 hours. Declined swap; referred customer to Retail Center with original ID or to call via an authorized M-PESA agent line as per SAKA SSCB-0006.

optional.label: Age <30d // Network Tenure
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006 / SCEK-0002]
If calling number has been on network for less than 30 days, decline swap and refer to Retail or nearest M-PESA agent to call via an agent line.
optional.violationAdvice: Calling number less than 30 days on network. Declined swap; referred customer to Retail Center or nearest M-PESA agent to call via an agent line as per SAKA SSCB-0006.

optional.label: Roaming // VLR ≠ 254
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006 / ROIE-0010]
If SAWA VLR does not start with 254, caller is roaming. Decline and advise to email customercare@safaricom.co.ke.
optional.violationAdvice: Calling number is roaming (VLR non-254). Referred customer to write to customercare@safaricom.co.ke as per roaming procedure.

optional.label: >2 Swaps/24h // Daily Limit
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006 / SCEK-0002]
Calling line is allowed a maximum of 2 SIM swap requests for other lines in 24 hours (unless verified M-PESA agent). Where exceeded, decline and refer to retail or advise them to call from an agent line.
optional.violationAdvice: Calling number exceeded maximum of 2 SIM swap requests in 24 hours. Declined swap; referred to Retail Center or to call via an authorized M-PESA agent line as per SAKA SSCB-0006.

optional.label: Agent Line // Verified Modifier
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
If caller is verified M-PESA Agent (Assistant ID, Agent No, ID match on G2 & Siebel), caller is exempt from <72h, <30d, and >2 swap limits.

optional.label: Whitelisted // *100*100#
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006 / SSCB-0003]
If line is self-whitelisted (*100*100#), Contact Center cannot swap. Refer customer to Retail Center with original ID.
optional.violationAdvice: Line is self-whitelisted (*100*100#). Declined and referred customer to Retail Center with original ID.

optional.label: Golden Number // Special
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
Golden, Platinum, or Super Platinum special numbers cannot be swapped via Contact Center. Refer customer to Safaricom Retail Shop.
optional.violationAdvice: Line to swap is a Golden/Platinum special number. Declined and referred to Safaricom Retail Shop.

optional.label: Outbound Unanswered // 2 Attempts
optional.info:
[SAKA SSCB-0006]
Outbound call made to line to be swapped was unanswered after 2 attempts. Refer customer to Retail Center.
optional.violationAdvice: Outbound call to line to be swapped was unanswered after 2 attempts. Declined and referred to Retail Center.

comments: Customer vetted on primary and secondary details. Line swapped successfully. Educated on M-PESA activation.
Customer failed secondary vetting. Advised to confirm FDN 1 and FDN 2 and call back.

types.name: M-PESA Reversal

required.label: Calling Number
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Mandatory calling number. If calling on behalf, capture caller number on interaction.

required.label: Transaction ID
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
10-character alphanumeric transaction reference (e.g. TGI7...).

required.label: Sender Number
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
MSISDN of the person who initiated the transaction.

required.label: Sender Name // 2 Names
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Confirm ownership using Customer Name as per M-PESA G3. Accept if customer gives 2 correct names.

required.label: Amount
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Exact amount sent in the transaction.

required.label: Recipient Number / Till
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003 / LBCF-0003]
Party B phone number, Buy Goods Till number, or Pochi wallet.

required.label: Date & Time // <30 days
required.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003 / MALP-0001]
Transaction must be within last 30 days for M-PESA P2P.

optional.label: Not Active // IN-Data
optional.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Calling number must be active on IN-Data (Active or Expiry state). If inactive or terminated, decline reversal request.
optional.violationAdvice: Calling number is not active on IN-Data. Declined and advised customer to call back with an active line.

optional.label: Roaming // VLR ≠ 254
optional.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003 / ROIE-0010]
If SAWA VLR does not start with 254, caller is roaming. Decline and advise to email customercare@safaricom.co.ke.
optional.violationAdvice: Calling number is roaming (VLR non-254). Referred customer to write to customercare@safaricom.co.ke as per roaming procedure.

optional.label: Reversal Type
optional.info:
[SAKA MRMM-0003]
Specify transaction type: P2P, LNM Till, or Pochi la Biashara.

optional.label: SR Number // 72h SLA
optional.info:
[SAKA LBCF-0003 / LPPP-0014]
Service Request number if escalated to LNM/Admin team (72h SLA). Normal P2P SLA is 2 hours.

comments: P2P reversal initiated on G3. Verified sender names and transaction within 30 days. Advised on 2h SLA.
Buy Goods / Till Reversal requested. Verified transaction details. Escalated to Merchant Support via SR (72h SLA).
Transaction older than 30 days. Advised customer to liaise directly with recipient or police.
Funds already utilized by recipient on M-PESA. Advised sender to liaise directly with recipient or report to police.

diyActions.label: DIY Till (*100#)
diyActions.adviceText: Educated on *100# Buy Goods self-service reversal

Amount paid to Paybill.

Shortcode paid to.

required.label: Correct Account Number

Reversal declined: Airtime balance partially/fully utilized on recipient line.
